scripts.setup_env:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env')) { fs.writeFileSync('.env', 'DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"
JWT_SECRET="super_secure_jwt_secret_key_123"
DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD="admin"
'); console.log('.env file created successfully.'); } else { console.log('.env file already exists.'); }"
scripts.install_all: npm run setup_env && npm install && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.server: npx prisma db push && tsx watch backend/server.ts
scripts.all: npm run install_all && npm run dev
